authorization.evidence: Chat 01a14e21-a9d4-7953-a208-4fb02fdf03db on 2026-10-18: user approved starting queued Issue104 and its sequential consequential workflow.

scope.S104-1: Design and implement explicitly supported US/EU ETF listing eligibility and currency-aware portfolios through source evidence, screening, deterministic policy/construction, explanation, dashboard and persisted restoration; extend vision/current architecture via new ADR.

non_goals: No authentication, brokerage, trades, external financial writes, tax or suitability assurance, hosting or worldwide listings.
No broad catalogue ingestion or candidate selection UI from Issue105, comparison/overlap project from Issues100/101, optimizer or arbitrary category inference.
No historical ticket reset, old certificate or allowance transfer, unrelated cleanup or live saved-review mutation.

invariants.INV104-1: Listing exchange/region, ETF verification, domicile, underlying geography, trading currency and portfolio base currency remain distinct source-attributed concepts; unknown, unsupported or contradictory required identity never silently qualifies.
invariants.INV104-2: Known cross-listings/share classes cannot count the same known economic exposure as independent diversification; unknown economic identity is explicit under a frozen conservative policy.
invariants.INV104-3: Deterministic weights total exactly 10000 basis points; initial and recurring cash reconcile independently and exactly in declared base-currency minor units. Mixed currencies are never summed or relabelled without approved attributable fresh conversion evidence.
invariants.INV104-4: Financial category, liquidity unit, FX source/freshness/missingness and eligibility policies are frozen in separate approved design before implementation; missing/stale/conflicting required evidence produces explicit exclusions or blockers.
invariants.INV104-5: JSON serialization, revision/restoration, dashboard recomputation, source timestamps, explanation grounding/safety and deterministic side-effect boundaries remain fail closed; existing supported US behavior is preserved or explicitly versioned by approved design.

interfaces: Evidence/source research models and provenance; listing eligibility/screening; profile and deterministic policy/construction; explanation references; dashboard presentation; checkpoint/revision restoration. Exact affected signatures/versioning are to be frozen in architect handoff before implementation.
Replaceable external data interfaces only where required by approved FX policy; no financial-write interface.
capsule.json_state_impact: Nested typed source/evidence, profile/policy/construction, explanation and restoration JSON will need explicit listing/currency/identity semantics and compatibility dispatch. Architect must freeze exact schema/version/default/rejection behavior before writes; no implicit relabelling or historical checkpoint repair.

acceptance.AC104-1: Separate architect handoff, independent challenge and coordinator approval freeze supported exchanges, ETF verification, identity/cross-listings, base/trading currencies, category coverage, liquidity units and attributable FX/freshness policy before implementation.
acceptance.AC104-2: US and exchange-qualified EU positive controls pass the frozen contract; non-ETF, non-US/EU, unknown, absent or conflicting required identity fail with explicit reasons. Domicile or asset geography never substitutes for listing.
acceptance.AC104-3: Known duplicate economic exposure across cross-listings/share classes is not counted as distinct diversification; unknown identity has explicit deterministic behavior and focused tests.
acceptance.AC104-4: Exact weights, initial and recurring cash reconcile in declared base currency, including zero/tiny totals and mixed currency cases; missing/stale/unsupported conversion evidence and unsupported categories yield explained blocked outcomes under approved policy.
acceptance.AC104-5: JSON round-trip, tampered/restored state, revision invalidation, dashboard recomputation and explanation grounding tests cover new contracts and existing US regressions. Update vision, architecture, new ADR, iteration evidence and reproducible offline evaluation comparisons with actual coverage limitations.

verification: Focused source identity/listing/currency/FX/category/liquidity/cross-listing boundary tests using attributed deterministic fixtures.
Exact cents/basis-point and JSON round-trip/restoration/dashboard/explanation/revision tests; US regression and same-case offline baseline comparison.

Repository required test/lint/type/build/workflow gates and independent implementation review. Live probes only where needed to establish source contract, with explicit limits; no live trade or saved-review mutation.
documentation: New ADR freezing consequential US/EU and currency contract; update product vision/current architecture.
Issue104 design/implementation iteration records, user-facing limitations and verification evidence; durable ticket ledger and issue/PR gate records.
risks: Yahoo identity/currency/category/FX coverage may be missing or conflict; supported eligibility must remain explicit and fail closed.
Cross-listing identity and historical JSON integrity may require conservative exclusions/versioning rather than guessed migrations.
Broad interface reach must not expand into Issue105 or change unrelated portfolio optimization.
escalation_triggers: Consequential ambiguity requires architect clarification within finite design allowance and independent challenge; repeated concerns require coordinator arbitration.
Concrete unresolved implementation failure, concurrency or migration complexity may justify specialist with recorded evidence.
Independent review required for financial and persistence contracts; failed final review stops for explicit finite decision.
